description: The s3-no-encryption case written as .tf.json instead of HCL
note: Proves .tf.json is in the snapshot. tfsec parses it; checkov 3.3.16 does not scan .tf.json on a directory walk -- terraform/tf_parser.py:580 carries `# TODO: add support for .tf.json` -- so CKV_AWS_145 is dropped from the label as a tool gap, the same way aws_instance is tfsec-blind for public IPs. Trivy deprecated aws-s3-enable-bucket-encryption (AWS-0088) once AWS began encrypting S3 by default; AWS-0132 (customer-managed key) is what fires on a bare bucket and is the Trivy-side twin of CKV_AWS_145.
